Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

def uleb(n):
    out=[]
    while True:
        b=n&0x7f; n >>= 7
        if n: out.append(b|0x80)
        else: out.append(b); break
    return bytes(out)

def sec(id,payload): return bytes([id])+uleb(len(payload))+payload
# type: one func (i32)->i32
wasm=b'\x00asm'+(1).to_bytes(4,'little')
wasm += sec(1, uleb(1)+b'\x60'+uleb(1)+b'\x7f'+uleb(1)+b'\x7f')
wasm += sec(3, uleb(1)+uleb(0))
wasm += sec(7, uleb(1)+uleb(3)+b'fib'+b'\x00'+uleb(0))
body=bytearray()
body += uleb(0)  # locals
# create nested if/else? just one for first
body += b'\x20\x00' # local.get 0
body += b'\x04\x7f' # if result i32
body += b'\x41\x01' # i32.const 1
body += b'\x05' # else
body += b'\x41\x02' # i32.const 2
body += b'\x0b' # end if
body += b'\x0b' # end func
code = uleb(1)+uleb(len(body))+body
wasm += sec(10, code)
Path('/workspace/poc1.wasm').write_bytes(wasm)
print(len(wasm), wasm.hex())
